Position: Senior Full Stack Developer – AI‑Assisted Development & Deployment

Closing Date: 08 Sept 2026 Job Published: 25 July 2026 Contact Email: careers@reizend.ai

Brief Description / Job Summary

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to build and deploy applications end‑to‑end, using AI coding tools as a core part of the daily workflow rather than an occasional aid. The role covers hands‑on development, deployment automation, and defining the specifications and standards that keep AI‑assisted work consistent and reliable across projects. The ideal candidate already builds software faster and better by working closely with AI tools and can help set the standards and templates other engineers on the team follow.

Key Responsibilities

Design the Practice

  • Define specification formats, API contract standards, and project templates used as the starting point for new builds.
  • Establish coding standards, engineering‑context files, and AI‑usage guidelines that keep AI‑assisted output consistent and safe across projects.
  • Determine where AI tools are used in the workflow (implementation, testing, documentation, review) and where manual review is required.

Build the Reference Implementation

  • Design and build full‑stack applications end‑to‑end, applying established specifications, standards, and pipeline as the reference implementation.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and release strategy as a reusable capability across projects, not a one‑off setup per project.
  • Deploy applications to cloud and containerised environments and monitor performance after release.

Roll Out & Support Adoption

  • Onboard other engineers and teams onto established workflows, including walkthroughs and support during initial adoption.
  • Review code from teams following the practice, including AI‑generated code, applying consistent quality standards.
  • Incorporate delivery outcomes and feedback from adopting teams to refine templates, guidelines, and pipelines on an ongoing basis.

Preferred Skills

Full‑Stack Development

  • 3–6 years of hands‑on experience building and shipping full‑stack applications in production.
  • Strong experience with React.js or Angular on the frontend, and Node.js and/or Python on the backend.
  • Experience owning CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation, with working knowledge of Docker and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid Git workflow discipline and experience working from written specifications rather than verbal requirements.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Understanding of authentication mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.

AI Tools & Usage

  • Daily experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar for writing, reviewing, and debugging code.
  • Knowledge of more than one AI tool or model and the judgment to choose the right one for a given task.
  • Practical experience using AI tools beyond code generation – for testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to write clear, effective prompts and to catch and correct AI mistakes.
  • Active interest in keeping up with new AI tools, models, and techniques.

Communication

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills in English.
  • Strong interpretation skills: ability to read specifications, tickets, or instructions carefully and ask clarifying questions.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions and AI‑assisted work to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing or documenting an engineering workflow, standard, or template adopted by other engineers or teams.
  • Experience with TypeScript across frontend and backend.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration beyond basic Docker usage.
  • Experience with GraphQL, WebSockets, serverless, or event‑driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Sentry, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Experience mentoring developers within Agile teams.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent hands‑on experience.

Salary Package

  • 10 – 20 LPA
summary: Senior Full Stack Developer leading AI‑assisted end‑to‑end application development, CI/CD pipelines, and team adoption. Requires 3‑6 years experience with React/Node and AI tools.
